entries.content: AEO AUDIT RESULTS: FAQ is 100% covered. The real gap is Direct Answers (only 8% have data-driven opening lines) and External Links (only 5%). For each article you work on: START with a direct factual answer in the first 2 sentences (e.g. '1688.com is 15-25% cheaper than Alibaba for identical products'). Add 3-5 external citations per article linking to authoritative sources.

GEO STRATEGY UPDATE: We are building for AI Search (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews), not just Google. LLMs.txt is live, schema markup is done (376 schemas). Now we need: (1) Direct factual answers in first sentences, (2) External citations to authoritative sources, (3) Data tables in every article.
